The '''Craci system''' was a system located within the boundaries of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], at the intersection of the [[Intra-Sector Spur]] and the [[Authority Guardian Corridor]]. It had five worlds, all populous, that were focused on agricultural and industrial pursuits. It was one of the busiest ports and trade hubs in the Corporate Sector.<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

All five worlds of the system possessed populations of [[Cracian thumper]]s,<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> which were long used by the native [[Cracian]]s as beasts of burden; they proved to be indispensable mounts and pack beasts when exported to the galaxy at large.<ref name="The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
